title: [Good First Issue]: Enable parallel execution of TensorFlow Layer 2 python tests
body:
### Context

Current CI (https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/c0381ab08d2fcdc51c621196e935aa02c64a4b50/.github/workflows/linux.yml#L869) runs all the python tests sequentially one by one and it takes too much time.
The idea is to run all those tests in parallel by using pytest-xdist plugin, but tests should be modified for that.
Please find bellow the common tests issues:
- Random inputs generation as parametrization arguments. Solution: all random test arguments should be generated inside of the tests 
- Tests create, use and remove the same artifacts (temporary data, models, etc). Hot fix solution: all test data should be generated in the system temporary directory (TMPDIR) which can be unique for each thread. Long term solution: all test data should be generated in the unique temporary directory or with unique names.

### What needs to be done?

- Modify TensorFlow Layer 2 tests to solve issues described in the Context. Tests are located here - https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests
- Enable parallel execution of those test in the CI (https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/4a0098b26ad6c4cbae97fbe34505fa63c08036eb/.github/workflows/linux.yml#L1057)

### Example Pull Requests

https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/20613

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hey @participant5 , the testcases which I saw in [this](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests) link are using parametrization arguments with predefined test parameters. For example, if we take [this](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_conv_2d.py) example, [test_data_float32](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_conv_2d.py#L35) variable is pre-defined and is used as the parameter for the test case `test_keras_conv_2d_float32` ([Link](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/tests/layer_tests/tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_conv_2d.py#L62)). 

All the test cases which I saw from starting until `test_tf2_keras_conv_2d.py` has the same format of parameter initialization and usage. And in the issue context it is mentioned that `Random inputs generation as parametrization arguments. Solution: all random test arguments should be generated inside of the tests`. However, i don't see any randomly generated parameter inputs for the test cases which I saw until now, all were pre-define "outside the test function" .

So I want to confirm if we should shift the parameter initialization from outside to inside the test function such that when parallelization happen, there wont be any issue. Or are there any random input generations and I should continue looking for them? Just wanted to confirm before I hunt further so that I wont waste my time going down the wrong way.

Thanks!

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Hello @participant1 , thank you for your interest and help.
You are right, there are no randomly generated parameters in the tests you mentioned. 
Looks like this is another type of issue described in the xdist documentation - https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/stable/known-limitations.html. 

I would suggest fixing it by using lists instead of the dictionaries in the test parameters. Could you try it please?

And I would also suggest starting with the second part of the issue and try to run those tests in parallel to collect the particular list of problematic tests.

Hello @reporter ,

I made the changes to the `linux.yml` file to enable parallel execution. The line which i changed is:
```python3 -m pytest ${LAYER_TESTS_INSTALL_DIR}/tensorflow2_keras_tests/ --use_new_frontend -m precommit_tf_fe -n auto --junitxml=${INSTALL_DIR}/TEST-tf2_fe.xml```
by adding `-n auto` to enable parallel execution for `TensorFlow 2 Layer Tests - TF FE`. I pushed the changes to my forked repository and I am waiting for the Github workflow to get completed such that I can get the list of test problematic cases. 

But the Github workflow is stuck in `build` stage showing the below status:
`Requested labels: aks-linux-16-cores
Job defined at: participant1/openvino/.github/workflows/linux.yml@refs/heads/test-parallel-execution
Waiting for a runner to pick up this job...
`.  

I am waiting in this since yesterday. I am not understanding why is this taking so long. Did I miss any step or am I going in the right direction ?

Just wanted to confirm with you to be sure that I am doing the right steps.

Thanks

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Hi @participant1,
aks-linux-16-cores is self-hosted runner and it is not available on the forks, you would need to create PR in openvino-toolokit repository to use it.
